content.text: Found Nano Banana 2.1 (~3.5 credits). Fill in its `contract` and call weave_run_model with id "bebebed5-50c1-4701-98b3-86929db21585" — that call quotes the actual cost and takes the user's approval before spending anything.

prompt.label: prompt
prompt.description: Description of the edits you want to make

images.description: The image you want to edit

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution of the image to generate.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image. Default means 1:1 for text to image or match one of the input image's aspect ratio for image editing

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: File format of the generated image.

thinking_level.title: Thinking
thinking_level.description: How much the model reasons before it generates. Higher can help complex prompts.

enable_web_search.title: Enable Web Search
enable_web_search.description: Enable web search for the image generation task. This will allow the model to use the latest information from the web to generate the image.
